```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const scfCustomDomain = new tencentcloud.scf.CustomDomain("scf_custom_domain", {
    domain: "xxxxxx",
    protocol: "HTTP",
    endpointsConfigs: [{
        namespace: "default",
        functionName: "xxxxxx",
        qualifier: "$LATEST",
        pathMatch: "/aa/*",
    }],
    wafConfig: {
        wafOpen: "CLOSE",
    },
});
```

## Import



scf scfCustomDomain can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Scf/customDomain:CustomDomain scf_custom_domain ${domain}
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
